headline: Revenue and profit fall sharply on both comparisons
summary_short: EQT's Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS was $0.34, down 85.6% q/q and 73.8% y/y, as net income of $211.4M fell 85.8% sequentially and 73.0% from a year ago.
summary_long: Diluted EPS of $0.34 fell 85.6% q/q and 73.8% y/y. Revenue of $1,809.9M dropped 46.4% q/q and 29.2% y/y. Operating income of $394.0M fell 80.6% q/q and 65.2% y/y; EBITDA of $1,131.4M declined 58.7% q/q and 37.9% y/y. Net income of $211.4M fell 85.8% q/q and 73.0% y/y, and pretax income of $366.4M followed the same pattern (-81.6% q/q, -66.5% y/y). Total cash of $112.9M fell 65.4% q/q and 79.7% y/y. Long-term debt of $5,655.7M eased 5.6% q/q and 32.0% y/y. Shareholders' equity of $25,258.9M rose 0.6% q/q and 17.9% y/y.
